tenderSchedule.title: BELURU TALUK
tenderSchedule.description:
INVITING A TENDER FOR PROVIDING A VEHICLE(LGV/MINIMUM 01 MT CAPACITY) FOR 
 TRANSPORTING AND DISTRIBUTING WHOLE MILK POWDER OF KSHEERA BHAGYA 
 SCHEME FROM CHANNARAYAPATTANA MILK CHILLING CENTER GODOWN TO 
 GOVERNMENT AND AIDED SCHOOLS OF BELURU TALUK.
 THE BIDDER SHOULD QUOTE RATE PER KILOGRAM(KG) BASIS ONLY(THE QUOTE RATE 
 INCLUDES TRANSPORTING OF MILK POWDER FROM CHANNARAYAPATTANA MILK 
 CHILLING CENTER GODOWN TO SCHOOLS, LOADING AND UNLOADING OF MILK POWDER 
 AND TOLL FEE).
 APPROX 5000 KG PER MONTH AND NUMBERS OF SCHOOLS TO BE SUPPLIED 
 APPROX-273.
tenderSchedule.deptName: Karnataka Co-operative Milk Producers Federation Limited
tenderSchedule.locationName: Managing Director Hassan Co-operative Milk Producers Union Union Pvt (PI)

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
THE BIDDER SHOULD FOLLOW ALL TERMS AND CONDITIONS OF TENDER DOCUMENT

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: THE BIDDER SHOULD FURNISH ALL TECHNICAL DOCUMENT AS PER TENDER DOCUMENT
